647:t_006:15.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I cannot comprehend this... Why does anyone side with Earthlings?」

647:t_006:16.en:
$$アル$$
「You should accept the facts. With stubborn AIs like you around, even I will be lumped in with you.」

647:t_006:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't worry, $$アル$$. At least you aren't as foolish as they are.」

647:t_006:18.en:
$$アル$$
「They are hardly a valid point of comparison, Sergeant.」

647:t_006:22.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「In a sense, they too are beings whose existence has been warped by the $$御使い$$s.」

647:t_006:24.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「They are the same as the $$アンチスパイラル$$. They despaired at what lay beyond humanity's evolution, and so concluded that they must destroy it.」

647:t_006:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that's why you wrecked $$ビアル星$$, where $$勝平$$'s ancestors lived, and Uncle $$梅本$$'s $$ガバール星$$?!」

647:t_006:26.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Earth, the planet those people ultimately reached...」

647:t_006:27.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「As we thought, Earth is the root of all evil...」

647:t_006:28.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「We shall erase them... every Earthling from every world.」

647:t_006:29.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut the hell up! I've heard enough out of you!」

647:t_006:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're the ones who protect Earth...!」

647:t_006:31.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「As you walk toward the future that hope points to, you are guardian gods bearing the sun's radiance! Now unleash that power!」

647:t_007:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We're gonna beat $$ガイゾック$$ for your ancestors, for Uncle $$梅本$$, and for everyone on Earth!」

647:t_007:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hang in there, everyone on Earth!」

647:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm ending $$ガイゾック$$ right here! I'll never let a damn machine destroy another peaceful planet!」

647:t_008:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have confirmed that all enemies are destroyed. The remaining ships will join us shortly.」

647:t_008:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Good work. We've chalked up a win in our first battle, at least.」

647:t_008:2.en:
$$葵$$
「And I intend to keep on winning every battle from here on.」

647:t_008:3.en:
$$シン$$
「The moment we lose, Earth's defeat is sealed too.」

647:t_008:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let's join the other ships first, then head for the center of the galaxy.」

647:t_008:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$... Do you know anything about the $$御使い$$s' stronghold?」

647:t_008:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Oh, come on... We're allies now, so let's quit keeping secrets like that.」

647:t_008:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「They are certainly the greatest and strongest enemy in the True War, the so-called war of the gods. But little is known of their true nature.」

647:t_008:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「What we do know is that they existed long before we gods of $$オリュンポス$$.」

647:t_008:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$, who retains his memories as a $$堕天翅$$, mentioned 120 million years.」

647:t_008:14.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then they're that old too...」

647:t_008:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If the great collapse of the universe occurs in a 120-million-year cycle, perhaps they have existed since the universe began.」

647:t_008:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whatever they really are, we have to protect Earth from them.」

647:t_008:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we keep going, we're bound to run into those bastards again anyway. We can ask everything we want to know then.」

647:t_008:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's go. We're headed for the center of the galaxy.」

647:t_008:19.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'm heading out, everyone... We've beaten $$ガイゾック$$, but our fight still isn't over...)

647:t_008:20.en:
$$勝平$$
(But I'll definitely come back. Earth is the home we're meant to return to.)

647:t_009:0.en:
$$勝平$$
($$ガイゾック$$...! I won't lose to you!)

647:t_009:1.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'm not the kid who fought in tears after you wiped out his sleep training anymore! I'm going to... become a guardian god of Earth too!)

647:t_010:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「So $$ガイゾック$$ really is gone for good now...」

647:t_010:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We don't know that. There might still be some $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$s left somewhere.」

647:t_010:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「If they come after us, we'll take them on.」

647:t_010:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「And we aren't the only ones. I'm sure every planet has people who keep doing their best to live without giving in to those bastards' accusations.」

647:t_010:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「If those people keep fighting, they won't lose to scum like that.」

647:t_010:5.en:
$$万丈$$
(That's right, $$勝平$$. And you're one of those people doing their utmost to live.)

647:t_010:6.en:
$$万丈$$
(You're no longer a boy... You're a full-fledged warrior protecting Earth and this universe.)

647:t_011:1.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I came to observe Prince $$グーラ$$ in battle, but it seems you have found me...」

647:t_011:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You're $$ロビー$$, the one who was with $$グーラ$$...!」

647:t_011:3.en:
$$ロビー$$
「Please keep my presence a secret. This is not exactly a reward, but I would like you to have this.」

647:t_012:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you. If you'd like, you could join us too...」

647:t_012:1.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I cannot. Though I infiltrated his forces for revenge, I destroyed many planets as a subordinate of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.」

647:t_012:2.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I can only entrust my wish for peace to Prince $$グーラ$$ and depart.」

647:t_012:4.en:
$$ロビー$$
「With a friend as pure of heart as you beside him, Prince $$グーラ$$'s path ahead will surely be filled with light.」

647:t_012:5.en:
$$ロビー$$
「I shall pray for your victory from afar.」

647:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Sure, you may be stronger than us...! But does that give you the right to look down on us and do whatever you want with our lives?!」

647:t_100:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「If you're going to impose your logic by force, we'll fight back with force! Don't complain, evil gods of $$ミケーネ$$!!」

647:t_101:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「You're people who relied on $$皇帝ズール$$'s power and lost sight of what really matters!」

647:t_101:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your psychic powers and mine should exist to open the way to the future! If you use them for an evil god, I'll never forgive you!」

647:t_102:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is a black hole incarnate, then $$鉄人$$ is the Messenger of the Sun!」

647:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't lose, $$鉄人$$! Use your power of the sun to dispel the darkness of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s minions!」

647:t_103:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father...! If you can hear me, please listen to what I'm saying!」

647:t_103:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Earthlings possess the heart you have forgotten, Father!」

647:t_103:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Please remember, Father! That heart will surely become the power to save the universe!」

647:t_104:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Let's do this, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$! We're gonna beat them on behalf of the $$神ファミリー$$!」

647:t_104:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I'm ready whenever you are, $$勝平$$! $$ザンボット$$ will answer us too!」

647:t_104:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「Let's fight for everyone waiting on Earth, and for everyone living in this universe!」

647:t_104:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, $$ガイゾック$$! Whatever you say, I'll never stop believing in people!!」

647:t_105:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're the enemy of $$勝平$$'s ancestors, the people of $$ビアル星$$! The enemy of Uncle $$梅本$$'s people on $$ガバール星$$!」

647:t_105:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And you're the enemy attacking our Earth! Me, $$トライダー$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, and $c are taking you on!!」

647:t_106:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ガイゾック$$, so consumed by selfishness disguised as a mission! Your very existence is unforgivable!」

647:t_106:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「I believe in humanity! And as a human, I will crush your ambitions!」

647:t_106:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$ガイゾック$$! If you do not fear the radiance of the sun and the gleam of moonlight illuminating the darkness, come at me!!」

647:t_107:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Whether this is a war of gods or a war between gods and demons matters not! As a living being myself, I fight only for all that lives!」

kept_omissions: 647:t_006:26: The planet Earth is identified before Gaizok states his conclusion in t_006:27.

647:t_008:7: Zeus trails after "Unfortunately" in response to the question about the Adversaries' stronghold; Watta asks him to stop keeping secrets before Zeus explains why he cannot provide that information.
647:t_011:0: The recognition question stops after "You are"; the subsequent identification resolves who appeared.
647:t_012:0: The invitation is deliberately left hanging; the following speaker responds to the implied invitation.
647:t_012:3: A name or identifying address is exclaimed without a completed clause; the speaker is reacting to the person addressed.
647:t_008:12: Zeus answers the preceding question about elapsed time with a comparative phrase; "longer than that" means longer than the suggested 12,000 years.
context_decisions: The Olympus god offers false or coercive assurances; the later Zeus guidance is sincere. Their statements are not treated as the same offer.
